description:
Noted in staging.rs module doc: 'When an article is staged but has not yet been written to IPFS, any reader request for that Message-ID must be served directly from the staging file. That integration point lives in the reader server ARTICLE/HEAD/BODY handler and is wired in when those handlers are implemented.'

Currently unimplemented. A client could POST an article, get a successful response, then immediately ARTICLE <msgid> and get 430 No Such Article because the article is in the staging area but not yet in the block store.

Fix: ARTICLE/HEAD/BODY/STAT handlers must check the staging area as a fallback when the block store lookup returns not-found. Staging file path is available via the transit_staging SQLite table (message_id → file_path). Reader and transit must share access to this table or the reader must have a read-only view of the staging directory.

Depends on stoa-3yz3y (staging WAL required) being in place first — no point fixing the reader path if staging is still optional.
title: fix: reader serves staged articles not yet in block store
